object.attr: derived: CF-V61 (D-V39). A link type is a traceability claim, and MELLON-VER-SRS-317 drops theirs silently. Answered on 2026-11-11 (Q-V8), to confirm. Replaces MELLON-VER-SRS-317 for link types.
object.description: When both sides of a merge changed one link's link type to different link types, the Resolve merge dialog shall ask the user for the link type.
